data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Create crates/kate-syntax/definitions/elixir-heex.xml by copying data/syntax/elixir-heex.xml from KSyntaxHighlighting commit 6d8ab7945958e7354295db7f399cce06f7de7571. Copy the whole file. Do not add a copyright comment. Do not remove an upstream comment. The language name is Elixir/HEEx. The license attribute is MIT. Do not change the license attribute. Do not add a second syntax file. Do not edit repository.rs. Do not add an include_str line. Do not edit SOURCES.md. Do not edit the six files that are already vendored. Do not edit abnf.xml, adblock.xml, ahdl.xml, antlr.xml, asm-arm.xml, brightscript.xml, cabal.xml, or capnproto.xml. A reference to Tag##Elixir/EEx stays in the file. A reference to Text##Elixir/EEx stays in the file. Do not copy elixir-eex.xml. A reference to Normal##Elixir stays in the file. Do not copy elixir.xml. The license attribute of elixir.xml is LGPLv2+. A reference to Normal##JavaScript stays in the file. A reference to String##JavaScript stays in the file. Do not copy javascript.xml. The license attribute of javascript.xml is empty. A reference to Base##CSS stays in the file. Do not copy css.xml. The license attribute of css.xml is LGPL. A reference to FindEntityRefs##HTML stays in the file. A reference to FindHTML##HTML stays in the file. Do not copy html.xml. The license attribute of html.xml is LGPL. This file has no ##Comments reference. Do not add one. This packet adds no Rust test. cargo test -p kate-syntax --locked repository::tests::six_vendored_definitions_load_and_link stays green. Do not rewrite that test. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Start this copy after PKT-0028 is on main. PKT-0251 through PKT-0274 are already on main. Do not edit cashscript.xml, changelog.xml, cil.xml, clist.xml, cobol.xml, coffee.xml, commonlisp.xml, csv-pipe.xml, csv-semicolon.xml, csv-whitespace.xml, d2.xml, dart.xml, dockerfile.xml, dotenv.xml, doxygen.xml, or earthfile.xml.
